shorts.title: Is a Tiger's Skin Striped Too? 🐯
shorts.description:
TRUE or FALSE? If you shave a tiger, it's still striped. Guess before the timer, then comment if you got it right 👇 

Bonus fact: No two tigers have the same stripe pattern.

Full quiz episode on the channel.

shorts.title: Can a Cockroach Really Live Without Its Head? 🪳
shorts.description:
TRUE or FALSE? A cockroach can live for a week without its head. Guess before the timer, then comment if you got it right 👇 

Bonus fact: Cockroaches can hold their breath for around forty minutes.

Full quiz episode on the channel.
